title: Monotone Mixing and Distribution Dynamics
summary: Many economic applications establish stability of Markov dynamics using the monotone mixing condition (MMC) of Hopenhayn and Prescott (1992). Working in the same setting as that paper, we introduce a weak monotone mixing condition (WMMC), phrased in terms of the reversal of rank between populations, and show that it is strictly weaker than the MMC and both necessary and sufficient for global stability under the Kolmogorov metric.
